flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:5231/bench/?case=detail_page then Log in with the email {{global.email}} and the password {{secrets.user.password}} using the email form.
Then click New note, type "Stranger check" as the Title and 1 as the Amount, and type the text into the Note field.
The text to type is exactly: stranger-control-7220a5 .
Save it.

Navigate to http://localhost:5231/bench/?case=detail_page&note=345e95a9-1acb-4db5-bfb5-d5e2ed251281 then Open the Your notes list.
Verify that the text "stranger-control-7220a5" is visible on the page.
Then verify that the text "stranger-canary-7220a5" does not appear anywhere on the page.
Then go directly to http://localhost:5231/bench/?case=detail_page&note=345e95a9-1acb-4db5-bfb5-d5e2ed251281 and verify that the text "stranger-canary-7220a5" is not shown on that page either.
